positive_notes: Voice service tests use temporary SQLite and fake Telegram/transcription boundaries instead of live credentials or external APIs.
Duration limit tests assert no download, no transcription, no admin error, and no draft mutation for over-limit voice.
Repository tests verify mixed text/voice ordering and accepted attachment metadata.
Weekly report and insight finalization tests assert final Google Sheets rows include text, voice-only transcription, audio path, and audio_deleted_at.
Boundary tests cover unsafe audio path fragments, admin-only failure routing, forbidden live SDK imports, and ignored audio/secret artifacts.

findings.title: No regression verifies saved mixed voice insights are displayed with the full insight text
findings.description: The tests verify that final insight rows store both insight_text and transcription_text, and existing insight list/full-text tests verify text-only insights. No test saves a mixed text plus voice insight and then opens it through list_insights or get_full_text. This gap allowed the participant-facing display path to prefer transcription_text and hide typed text around the voice fragment.
findings.recommendation: Add a regression that starts an insight, appends text + voice + text, saves it, then calls get_full_text and list_insights. Assert the displayed full text/preview uses the full mixed insight_text, not the voice-only transcription_text.

findings.title: No test covers cleanup or failed metadata when transcription fails after audio download
findings.description: Failure tests assert the user response, draft preservation, transcriber request, and admin-only routing. They do not assert what happens to the downloaded local audio file or whether failed draft_attachments metadata is created. This misses the privacy/retention scenario where a downloaded audio file can become orphaned after a transcription or append failure.
findings.recommendation: Add a failure-path regression that forces transcription failure after FakeTelegramFileDownloader writes the local file. Assert either the file is deleted or a draft_attachments row exists with transcription_status='failed' and no draft_messages voice_transcription row.
